items.title: Albert French Interview
items.q: Oh I started playing with Celestan, I've been with the band now about ten years.

ctx.x: Did he call it the Tuxedo then too?

No, he called it Ridgely. Ridgely's band, yeah. Because after they broke up, I think Celestan took the Tuxedo and he just ridgely band after they separated. But the old man is still living. Oh yes, we interviewed him once. He did, uh-huh. He's still living, Ridgely's still living. I was trying to think of some other bands.
When did you start with Celestan?
